clustering.method: KMeans on the 339 actual failures' raw sensor readings only -- Type and the TWF/HDF/PWF/OSF/RNF flags were withheld from clustering entirely
clustering.validation_note: the failure-mode flags were never used to fit the clusters -- they are used here only after the fact, to check whether the unsupervised structure recovered something mechanically real
clustering.finding: Clustering on raw sensor readings alone only weakly recovers this dataset's documented failure mechanisms (Adjusted Rand Index 0.04 vs the TWF/HDF/PWF/OSF/RNF labels, which the clustering never saw). The purest cluster is 84% 'PWF' failures, with mean torque 12.4Nm and tool wear 115.6min -- a distinct mechanical signature found with zero access to the failure-mode label.

anomaly_detection.method: IsolationForest, contamination=0.034 (matched to the known population failure rate), fit with NO access to the failure label
anomaly_detection.finding: Of the 5 failures the supervised model's cost-optimal threshold missed, the unsupervised anomaly detector independently flagged 0 of them as abnormal -- a real safety net, not a duplicate of the supervised signal.
